dataset_info.anti_leakage_note: Call duration is strictly excluded because it is only known after marketing contact, preventing data leakage and unrealistic performance claims.

logistic_regression.description: Regularized linear logistic regression estimating log-odds of term deposit subscription with balanced class weights.
logistic_regression.class_weight_note: class_weight='balanced' inversely proportional to class frequencies.
logistic_regression.interpretation: Logistic Regression achieved an Accuracy of 87.84%, F1-score of 44.89%, ROC-AUC of 77.20%, and Brier score of 0.0850. Under optimal thresholding on the held-out test partition, it produced 490 false positives (unconverted outbound calls) and 610 false negatives (missed conversion prospects). With a Recall of 42.34% and Precision of 47.76%, this calibrated pipeline balances term deposit conversion capture against outbound campaign resource expenditure.

decision_tree.description: Non-parametric CART decision tree partitioning feature space with balanced class weights.
decision_tree.class_weight_note: class_weight='balanced' weighting inversely proportional to class frequencies.
decision_tree.interpretation: Decision Tree Classifier achieved an Accuracy of 88.00%, F1-score of 47.51%, ROC-AUC of 77.76%, and Brier score of 0.0834. Under optimal thresholding on the held-out test partition, it produced 518 false positives (unconverted outbound calls) and 567 false negatives (missed conversion prospects). With a Recall of 46.41% and Precision of 48.66%, this calibrated pipeline balances term deposit conversion capture against outbound campaign resource expenditure.

knn.description: Instance-based non-parametric classifier voting in standardized feature space (KNN does not support a class_weight parameter).
knn.class_weight_note: No class_weight parameter is supported by KNeighborsClassifier in scikit-learn.
knn.interpretation: K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN) achieved an Accuracy of 86.42%, F1-score of 39.09%, ROC-AUC of 72.33%, and Brier score of 0.0897. Under optimal thresholding on the held-out test partition, it produced 564 false positives (unconverted outbound calls) and 664 false negatives (missed conversion prospects). With a Recall of 37.24% and Precision of 41.13%, this calibrated pipeline balances term deposit conversion capture against outbound campaign resource expenditure.

random_forest.description: Ensemble of bagging decision trees with balanced bootstrap subsamples and randomized feature subsets.
random_forest.class_weight_note: class_weight='balanced' adjusts weights inversely proportional to class frequencies.
random_forest.interpretation: Random Forest Classifier achieved an Accuracy of 86.97%, F1-score of 47.32%, ROC-AUC of 79.86%, and Brier score of 0.0822. Under optimal thresholding on the held-out test partition, it produced 649 false positives (unconverted outbound calls) and 529 false negatives (missed conversion prospects). With a Recall of 50.00% and Precision of 44.91%, this calibrated pipeline balances term deposit conversion capture against outbound campaign resource expenditure.

temporal_check.description: Chronological holdout of last 20% records in file order without shuffling.

statistical_verdict: The 95% confidence intervals for Decision Tree Classifier [0.4468, 0.5011] and Random Forest Classifier [0.4464, 0.4965] overlap. Their performances are not statistically distinguishable on this test set.
